=== FILE: C:\x_ud_FJdC_vProyecto_MSc\GitHub Publico\Transitorios_AIoT-IDF\Transitorios_AIoT-IDF\components\UARTn_AIoT\include\UARTn_AIoT.h ===
/*
 * File: components/UARTn_AIoT/include/UARTn_AIoT.h
 * Description: UART library for ESP-IDF. The logic lives in the C++ class
 *              UARTn_AIoT (src/UARTn_AIoT.cpp); this header exposes a C API
 *              with an opaque handle, so it can be used from C and C++.
 * Author: Ing. Ernesto JosÃ© Guerrero GonzÃ¡lez
 * Standards: ESP-IDF v5.5.1, C11 / C++. English comments.
 *
 * Life cycle:
 *   UARTn_handle_t gsm = UARTn_create(1, 17, 18, 115200);   // constructor
 *   UARTn_set_timeout(gsm, 500);                            // optional
 *   UARTn_init(gsm);                                        // hardware
 *   UARTn_write(gsm, "AT\r\n");
 *   UARTn_read_until(gsm, '\n', line, sizeof(line));
 *   UARTn_destroy(gsm);                                     // destructor
 *
 * Notes:
 *  - UART0 is the USB/serial console of the CrowPanel: use UART1 or UART2.
 *  - Pin value -1 keeps the default pin of that UART.
 *  - Frame format 8N1, no hardware flow control, RX buffer 2048 bytes.
 *  - Thread safe: one internal mutex per object.
 *  - RS-485 (e.g. Modbus RTU transmitters): call UARTn_set_rs485() before
 *    UARTn_init(); the driver then drives the transceiver DE/RE pin itself.
 */
#ifndef UARTN_AIOT_H
#define UARTN_AIOT_H

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include "esp_err.h"

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/* Opaque handle: points to a UARTn_AIoT C++ object */
typedef struct UARTn_Instance *UARTn_handle_t;

/* Default values */
#define UARTN_AIOT_RX_BUF_SIZE        2048   /* driver RX ring buffer (SIM800L safe) */
#define UARTN_AIOT_LINE_BUF_SIZE      512    /* internal line accumulator */
#define UARTN_AIOT_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS 1000   /* read timeout */

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Constructor / destructor                                                    */
/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/**
 * @brief Creates a UART object (constructor). No hardware is touched yet.
 * @param uart_num  UART port (0, 1 or 2 on the ESP32-S3)
 * @param tx_pin    TX GPIO (-1 = default pin)
 * @param rx_pin    RX GPIO (-1 = default pin)
 * @param baud_rate Baud rate (e.g. 9600, 115200)
 * @return Handle, or NULL if the arguments are invalid or there is no memory.
 */
UARTn_handle_t UARTn_create(int uart_num, int tx_pin, int rx_pin, int baud_rate);

/**
 * @brief Installs the UART driver and configures pins and baud rate.
 *        Calling it twice is harmless.
 * @return ESP_OK, ESP_ERR_INVALID_ARG, ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE (port already in
 *         use by another driver) or the driver error.
 */
esp_err_t UARTn_init(UARTn_handle_t handle);

/**
 * @brief Uninstalls the driver (only if it was installed) and frees the object
 *        (destructor). The handle must not be used afterwards.
 */
void UARTn_destroy(UARTn_handle_t handle);

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Configuration                                                               */
/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/**
 * @brief Sets the timeout of the read functions in milliseconds.
 *        0 = non-blocking (return immediately with whatever is available).
 */
void UARTn_set_timeout(UARTn_handle_t handle, uint32_t timeout_ms);

/**
 * @brief Changes the baud rate (works before and after UARTn_init).
 */
esp_err_t UARTn_set_baud_rate(UARTn_handle_t handle, int baud_rate);

/**
 * @brief Enables RS-485 half-duplex mode (call BEFORE UARTn_init).
 *        The UART hardware raises de_pin while transmitting and lowers it to
 *        receive. Wire it to DE and /RE (joined) of a MAX485/SP3485-type
 *        transceiver. The receiver is off while sending, so there is no echo.
 * @param de_pin GPIO connected to DE + /RE of the transceiver
 * @return ESP_OK, ESP_ERR_INVALID_ARG or ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE (already init)
 */
esp_err_t UARTn_set_rs485(UARTn_handle_t handle, int de_pin);

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Transmission                                                                */
/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/**
 * @brief Writes a null-terminated string.
 */
void UARTn_write(UARTn_handle_t handle, const char *msg);

/**
 * @brief Writes raw bytes (binary safe, 0x00 allowed).
 * @return Number of bytes written, or -1 on error.
 */
int UARTn_write_bytes(UARTn_handle_t handle, const uint8_t *data, size_t len);

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Reception                                                                   */
/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/**
 * @brief Reads one line ending with the terminator.
 *
 * - The terminator is consumed and NOT stored; the buffer is always
 *   null-terminated.
 * - Bytes received after the terminator stay in the UART buffer for the next
 *   call (nothing is lost).
 * - If the timeout expires before the terminator arrives, the partial line is
 *   kept inside the object and the function returns 0; the next call
 *   continues the same line. This allows polling with timeout 0.
 * - If the line is longer than max_len - 1, it is delivered in pieces.
 * - Empty lines (terminator with nothing before it) are skipped.
 *
 * @param handle     UART object
 * @param terminator End character (e.g. '\n')
 * @param buffer     Destination
 * @param max_len    Size of the destination INCLUDING the final '\0'
 * @return Characters stored (> 0 = complete line or piece), 0 = no complete
 *         line yet, -1 = error.
 */
int UARTn_read_until(UARTn_handle_t handle, char terminator, char *buffer, int max_len);

/**
 * @brief Reads up to len raw bytes, waiting at most the configured timeout.
 * @return Number of bytes read (may be less than len), -1 on error.
 */
int UARTn_read_bytes(UARTn_handle_t handle, uint8_t *data, size_t len);

/**
 * @brief Number of bytes waiting in the UART RX buffer.
 */
size_t UARTn_available(UARTn_handle_t handle);

/**
 * @brief Discards everything received (UART buffer and partial line).
 *        Useful before sending a command so the answer read afterwards is fresh.
 */
void UARTn_flush(UARTn_handle_t handle);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* UARTN_AIOT_H */

=== FILE: C:\x_ud_FJdC_vProyecto_MSc\GitHub Publico\Transitorios_AIoT-IDF\Transitorios_AIoT-IDF\components\WiFi_AIoT\src\WiFi_AIoT.c ===
/*
 * File: WiFi_AIoT.c
 * Description: WiFi Driver with Hostname configuration.
 * Author: Ing. Ernesto JosÃ© Guerrero GonzÃ¡lez
 * Standards: English comments for International Code Compliance.
 */

#include "WiFi_AIoT.h"
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdio.h> 
#include "freertos/FreeRTOS.h"
#include "esp_wifi.h"
#include "esp_log.h"
#include "esp_event.h"
#include "lwip/ip_addr.h"
#include "esp_netif.h"
#include "esp_timer.h" 
#include "esp_pm.h" // Power Management

static const char *TAG = "Wifi_AIoT";

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// State Variables
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
static char current_ssid[33] = "";
static char current_ip[16]   = "0.0.0.0";
static char current_dns[16]  = "0.0.0.0"; 
static char current_mac[18]  = "00:00:00:00:00:00";
static bool is_connected     = false;
static int64_t connection_start_time = 0;

// Power Management Lock Handle (Safe guard)
#if CONFIG_PM_ENABLE
static esp_pm_lock_handle_t cpu_freq_lock;
#endif

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Event Handler
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
static void event_handler(void* arg, esp_event_base_t event_base,
                                int32_t event_id, void* event_data)
{
    if (event_base == IP_EVENT && event_id == IP_EVENT_STA_GOT_IP) {
        ip_event_got_ip_t* event = (ip_event_got_ip_t*) event_data;
        sprintf(current_ip, IPSTR, IP2STR(&event->ip_info.ip));
        
        esp_netif_t *netif = event->esp_netif;
        esp_netif_dns_info_t dns_info;
        if (esp_netif_get_dns_info(netif, ESP_NETIF_DNS_MAIN, &dns_info) == ESP_OK) {
            sprintf(current_dns, IPSTR, IP2STR(&dns_info.ip.u_addr.ip4));
        }

        uint8_t mac[6];
        esp_wifi_get_mac(WIFI_IF_STA, mac);
        sprintf(current_mac, "%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X", mac[0], mac[1], mac[2], mac[3], mac[4], mac[5]);
        
        connection_start_time = esp_timer_get_time();
        is_connected = true;
        ESP_LOGI(TAG, "CONNECTED! IP:%s - Hostname: Transitorios-AIoT-v00", current_ip);
    }
    else if (event_base == WIFI_EVENT && event_id == WIFI_EVENT_STA_DISCONNECTED) {
        is_connected = false;
        connection_start_time = 0;
        ESP_LOGW(TAG, "Disconnected. Retrying...");
        esp_wifi_connect();
    }
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Initialization Function
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
void wifi_init_sta(void)
{
    static bool initialized = false;
    if (initialized) return;

    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(esp_netif_init());
    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(esp_event_loop_create_default());

    // 1. Create Interface and Set Hostname
    esp_netif_t *netif = esp_netif_create_default_wifi_sta();
    if (netif) {
        // RFC 952 Compliant Hostname
        esp_netif_set_hostname(netif, "Transitorios_AIoT-v00");
    }

    wifi_init_config_t cfg = WIFI_INIT_CONFIG_DEFAULT();
    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(esp_wifi_init(&cfg));

    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(esp_event_handler_instance_register(IP_EVENT, IP_EVENT_STA_GOT_IP, &event_handler, NULL, NULL));
    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(esp_event_handler_instance_register(WIFI_EVENT, WIFI_EVENT_STA_DISCONNECTED, &event_handler, NULL, NULL));

    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(esp_wifi_set_mode(WIFI_MODE_STA));
    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(esp_wifi_start());

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // STABILITY SECTION (Safe implementation)
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Disable WiFi Power Save to reduce latency
    esp_wifi_set_ps(WIFI_PS_NONE); 

    #if CONFIG_PM_ENABLE
    // Only locks CPU if Power Management is enabled in menuconfig
    if (esp_pm_lock_create(ESP_PM_CPU_FREQ_MAX, 0, "rgb_fix", &cpu_freq_lock) == ESP_OK) {
        esp_pm_lock_acquire(cpu_freq_lock);
        ESP_LOGI(TAG, "CPU Frequency Locked (Stability Mode Active)");
    }
    #else
    ESP_LOGW(TAG, "CPU Lock Skipped (Enable Power Management in menuconfig to fix screen jitter)");
    #endif
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    initialized = true;
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Connection & Scan Functions
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
void wifi_connect(const char *ssid, const char *password)
{
    strncpy(current_ssid, ssid, 32);
    wifi_config_t wifi_config = {0};
    strncpy((char *)wifi_config.sta.ssid, ssid, 32);
    strncpy((char *)wifi_config.sta.password, password, 64);
    
    esp_wifi_disconnect();
    esp_wifi_set_config(WIFI_IF_STA, &wifi_config);
    esp_wifi_connect();
}

char* wifi_scan_networks_get_list(void)
{
    wifi_scan_config_t scan_config = { .show_hidden = true };
    esp_wifi_scan_start(&scan_config, true);

    uint16_t ap_count = 0;
    esp_wifi_scan_get_ap_num(&ap_count);
    if (ap_count == 0) return NULL;

    wifi_ap_record_t *ap_list = (wifi_ap_record_t *)malloc(sizeof(wifi_ap_record_t) * ap_count);
    esp_wifi_scan_get_ap_records(&ap_count, ap_list);

    char *list_buffer = (char *)calloc(ap_count * 35, 1);
    if (list_buffer) {
        for (int i = 0; i < ap_count; i++) {
            if (strlen((char *)ap_list[i].ssid) > 0) {
                strcat(list_buffer, (char *)ap_list[i].ssid);
                if (i < ap_count - 1) strcat(list_buffer, "\n");
            }
        }
    }
    free(ap_list);
    return list_buffer;
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Getters & Utils
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
bool  get_wifi_is_connected(void) { return is_connected; }
char* get_wifi_ssid(void) { return current_ssid; }
char* get_wifi_ip(void)   { return current_ip; }
char* get_wifi_dns(void)  { return current_dns; } 
char* get_wifi_mac(void)  { return current_mac; }

int64_t get_wifi_connection_duration_us(void) {
    if (connection_start_time == 0) return 0;
    return esp_timer_get_time() - connection_start_time;
}

void WiFi_Get_Connection_Time_String(char *buffer, size_t len) {
    int64_t duration_us = get_wifi_connection_duration_us();
    if (duration_us == 0) {
        snprintf(buffer, len, "00:00:00"); 
        return;
    }
    int duration_sec = (int)(duration_us / 1000000); 
    int hours   = (duration_sec % 86400) / 3600;
    int minutes = (duration_sec % 3600) / 60;
    int seconds = (duration_sec % 60);
    snprintf(buffer, len, "%02d:%02d:%02d", hours, minutes, seconds);
}

=== FILE: C:\x_ud_FJdC_vProyecto_MSc\GitHub Publico\Transitorios_AIoT-IDF\Transitorios_AIoT-IDF\main\main_AIoT.c ===
/*
 * File: main/main_AIoT.c
 * Description: Application entry point.
 *              Core 1: RGB panel interrupts + LVGL + EEZ Flow (ui_task).
 *              Core 0: WiFi, lwIP, esp_timer and the rest of the system.
 * Author: Ing. Ernesto JosÃ© Guerrero GonzÃ¡lez
 * Standards: ESP-IDF v5.5.1, LVGL 9.x. English comments.
 *
 * Revision 3 (WiFi jitter fix):
 *  Symptom: once WiFi is connected the picture jumps/shifts even on a static
 *           screen. Before connecting (first video) it did not happen.
 *  Cause:   the RGB bounce-buffer refill runs in an interrupt that is allocated
 *           on the core that creates the panel. It was core 0, the same core as
 *           the WiFi driver interrupts and tasks; their latency made the refill
 *           arrive late -> DMA underrun -> image shifted until the next VSYNC.
 *  Fix:     the panel (and therefore its interrupts) is created INSIDE ui_task,
 *           which is pinned to core 1. WiFi keeps core 0 for itself.
 *
 * Revision 7 (instant tab change):
 *  The Main3 tabview content was horizontally scrollable: any small drag of
 *  the stylus on the resistive panel slid the content between the
 *  "Connec To WiFi" and "AIoT Transitorios" tabs with an animation.
 *  ui_apply_runtime_tweaks() disables that scrolling after ui_init(), so tabs
 *  change only with the tab bar buttons, instantly (LVGL uses LV_ANIM_OFF).
 *  Done here and not in the EEZ files, because EEZ regenerates screens.c.
 *
 * Start-up order (same as the original program):
 *   1. app_main  : NVS
 *   2. ui_task   : Configuracion_AIoT_Init()  (LCD + touch + LVGL on core 1)
 *   3. app_main  : IO_AIoT_Init(), wifi_init_sta()
 *   4. ui_task   : ui_init() and UI loop
 */
#include <stdio.h>
#include "freertos/FreeRTOS.h"
#include "freertos/task.h"
#include "freertos/semphr.h"
#include "esp_log.h"
#include "esp_timer.h"
#include "nvs_flash.h"
#include "esp_task_wdt.h"

/* Components */
#include "Configuracion_AIoT.h"
#include "System_Defines_AIoT.h"
#include "WiFi_AIoT.h"
#include "IO_AIoT.h"
#include "ui.h"
#include "screens.h"
#include "lvgl.h"

/* Custom UI logic (clock labels, WiFi status...) implemented in EEZ_AIoT */
extern void ui_update_periodic_task(void);

static const char *TAG = "Main_App";

/* Period for ui_update_periodic_task(): the uptime label has 250 ms
 * resolution, so 50 ms is more than enough. */
#define UI_PERIODIC_UPDATE_MS   50

/* Upper bound for the UI loop sleep (ms) */
#define UI_LOOP_MAX_SLEEP_MS    10

/* Start-up synchronization between app_main (core 0) and ui_task (core 1) */
static SemaphoreHandle_t s_hw_ready_sem = NULL;    /* ui_task  -> app_main */
static SemaphoreHandle_t s_sys_ready_sem = NULL;   /* app_main -> ui_task  */
static volatile esp_err_t s_hw_init_result = ESP_FAIL;

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Adjustments applied once after ui_init() (survive EEZ code regeneration)    */
/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
static void ui_apply_runtime_tweaks(void)
{
    /* Main3 tabview: no swipe between tabs, only instant tab-bar clicks */
    if (objects.tab_view_main2 != NULL) {
        lv_obj_t *tab_content = lv_tabview_get_content(objects.tab_view_main2);
        if (tab_content != NULL) {
            /* LVGL 9.6 dedicated setters (lv_obj_remove_flag is deprecated) */
            lv_obj_set_scrollable(tab_content, false);
            lv_obj_set_scroll_elastic(tab_content, false);
            lv_obj_set_scroll_momentum(tab_content, false);
        }
        ESP_LOGI(TAG, "Tabview: swipe disabled, instant tab change");
    }
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* UI task: the ONLY task that calls lv_* / EEZ functions without the mutex.   */
/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
static void ui_task(void *arg)
{
    (void)arg;
    ESP_LOGI(TAG, "UI task running on core %d", (int)xPortGetCoreID());

    /* 1. LCD + touch + LVGL. Created here so the RGB/GDMA interrupts that
     *    refill the bounce buffers are allocated on core 1, away from WiFi. */
    s_hw_init_result = Configuracion_AIoT_Init();
    xSemaphoreGive(s_hw_ready_sem);
    if (s_hw_init_result != ESP_OK) {
        ESP_LOGE(TAG, "Hardware initialization failed!");
        vTaskDelete(NULL);
        return;
    }

    /* 2. Wait until app_main has started the backlight PWM and WiFi */
    xSemaphoreTake(s_sys_ready_sem, portMAX_DELAY);

    /* 3. Build the EEZ UI (still single-threaded with respect to LVGL) */
    if (Configuracion_AIoT_Lock(0)) {
        ui_init();
        ui_apply_runtime_tweaks();
        Configuracion_AIoT_Unlock();
    }

    esp_task_wdt_add(NULL);
    int64_t last_periodic_us = 0;

    for (;;) {
        uint32_t time_until_next = UI_LOOP_MAX_SLEEP_MS;

        if (Configuracion_AIoT_Lock(0)) {
            /* A. LVGL timers: refresh, input read, animations */
            time_until_next = lv_timer_handler();

            /* B. EEZ Flow tick */
            ui_tick();

            /* C. Custom UI logic, throttled */
            int64_t now_us = esp_timer_get_time();
            if ((now_us - last_periodic_us) >= (UI_PERIODIC_UPDATE_MS * 1000LL)) {
                last_periodic_us = now_us;
                ui_update_periodic_task();
                IO_Task_Manager(); /* Backlight / auto-suspend state machine */
            }

            Configuracion_AIoT_Unlock();
        }

        /* D. Watchdog */
        esp_task_wdt_reset();

        /* E. Sleep until the next LVGL timer is due (1..10 ms) */
        if (time_until_next == LV_NO_TIMER_READY || time_until_next > UI_LOOP_MAX_SLEEP_MS) {
            time_until_next = UI_LOOP_MAX_SLEEP_MS;
        }
        if (time_until_next < 1) {
            time_until_next = 1;
        }
        vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(time_until_next));
    }
}

void app_main(void)
{
    /* 1. NVS (required by WiFi) */
    esp_err_t ret = nvs_flash_init();
    if (ret == ESP_ERR_NVS_NO_FREE_PAGES || ret == ESP_ERR_NVS_NEW_VERSION_FOUND) {
        ESP_ERROR_CHECK(nvs_flash_erase());
        ret = nvs_flash_init();
    }
    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(ret);

    s_hw_ready_sem = xSemaphoreCreateBinary();
    s_sys_ready_sem = xSemaphoreCreateBinary();
    if (s_hw_ready_sem == NULL || s_sys_ready_sem == NULL) {
        ESP_LOGE(TAG, "Could not create start-up semaphores");
        return;
    }

    /* 2. Start the UI task on core 1; it initializes the display hardware */
    BaseType_t ok = xTaskCreatePinnedToCore(ui_task, "ui_task",
                                            AIOT_UI_TASK_STACK_BYTES, NULL,
                                            AIOT_UI_TASK_PRIORITY, NULL,
                                            AIOT_UI_TASK_CORE);
    if (ok != pdPASS) {
        ESP_LOGE(TAG, "Could not create ui_task");
        return;
    }

    /* Wait for LCD + touch + LVGL to be ready */
    xSemaphoreTake(s_hw_ready_sem, portMAX_DELAY);
    if (s_hw_init_result != ESP_OK) {
        return;
    }

    /* 3. Backlight PWM and power management */
    IO_AIoT_Init();

    /* 4. WiFi station (WiFi task is pinned to core 0 by default) */
    wifi_init_sta();

    /* 5. Let the UI task build the screens and enter its loop */
    xSemaphoreGive(s_sys_ready_sem);

    ESP_LOGI(TAG, "System initialized on core %d. UI runs on core %d",
             (int)xPortGetCoreID(), AIOT_UI_TASK_CORE);
    /* app_main may return: its task is deleted, the scheduler keeps running */
}
